room.name: The Runway Coming Toward You
room.question: Where will the returning landing be when you need it?
room.hint: Wake the carriage, then use the steps to reach the sheltered ledge. Cross to the thin drop shelf. Wait for the return, drop through and dash down-left onto its roof, then jump left with the recovered dash. Dash upward beside the housing, land at home, then cross the upper gallery.

label: Ground dash from the drop shelf reaches the home exit without the returning roof
